_comment: ⭐ ZONE 1'S ONE ELITE, and the first elite a new player meets (content-zone-design-guide.md §2.4, the Mill on the river POI — a soft dead end whose reward is optional). curveLevel 6 puts it at the top of Z1's range, above EliteWolf's cL5. ⚑ FACTION wildlife_prey, NOT predator, and the reason is mechanical rather than flavour: wildlife_predator is hostileTo wildlife_prey, so an alpha authored as a predator would hunt the sounder it leads. Prey also means it never initiates — the mill fight is CHOSEN, which is what lets a level-3 player walk past the zone's one elite instead of being ambushed by it. It still retaliates: the threat table does not care about factions. ⭐ IT PAYS FOR ITS HP WITH SPEED, per the archetype rule (D6): 4.55x the Wolf's baseline at 0.71x its speed, which is also slower than the Boar it leads (0.55) — a tusker's threat is the blow, not the chase, and AlphaBoarGore is the other half of that shape (half the Boar's cadence at nearly three times the hit). ⚑ NO maxHealthVariance, deliberately breaking with EliteWolf/AlphaWolf: variance is a population spread, and one spawn is not a population — it would just be a coin flip on the zone's only elite fight. ⚑ ccImmune true is REQUIRED at tier elite (the loader refuses the boot without it). ⭐ DROPS: ThickHide is the point of the table — until now its only source was the DireBear, three zones away, and this is the mob whose own bleed tag is what Thick Hide answers. Hardy is the Z1 line-mate it shares with EliteWolf, so that slot shifts no reachability. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
name: AlphaBoar
